def transform(grid):
    # Two 4x5 patterns are separated by a color-4 divider.
    # Combine occupied cells (2 in the upper pattern, 1 in the lower)
    # into color 3.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 4 for v in row))
    top = grid[:sep]
    bottom = grid[sep + 1:]
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == 2 or bottom[r][c] == 1 else 0
             for c in range(len(top[r]))]
            for r in range(len(top))]
